subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat ship the full four-action long-press message menu requested here, or should maintainers narrow the first implementation to copy/select text only?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but Share and Reply add product behavior beyond basic copy/select, and an open conflicting implementation candidate already exists.

options.title: Review full action menu
options.body: Adopt or repair the linked long-press Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply implementation if maintainers want the complete Android message action surface.

options.title: Narrow to copy/select
options.body: Ship copy and selectable text first, leaving Share and Reply for a follow-up after Android UX review.

options.title: Defer message actions
options.body: Keep current code-block-only copy behavior until Android chat interaction priorities are scheduled explicitly.

recommendation.title: Review full action menu
recommendation.body: Adopt or repair the linked long-press Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply implementation if maintainers want the complete Android message action surface.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle appears in recent Android chat rendering and code-block work and as committer for adjacent Android markdown changes, making it the best available routing candidate for the product-scope choice.
